rows.note: For a spoken test, this is the all-purpose Cantonese noun.

example.english: I have an oral this Friday.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 ng5 jau5 hau2 si3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for something spoken rather than written, such as an oral presentation.

example.english: This course requires an oral presentation.
example.jyutping: ni1 fo1 jiu3 zou6 hau2 tau4 bou3 gou3

rows.jyutping: hau2 hong1 fong1 min6 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this when describing something relating specifically to the mouth or oral cavity, especially in health contexts.

example.english: I've had a few oral problems lately.
example.traditional: 我最近有少少口腔方面嘅問題。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 siu2 siu2 hau2 hong1 fong1 min6 ge3 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a medical examination of the mouth, not a spoken test.

example.english: The dentist said I need an oral examination.
example.traditional: 牙醫話我要做口腔檢查。
example.jyutping: ngaa4 ji1 waa6 ngo5 jiu3 zou6 hau2 hong1 gim2 caa4
